verdict.rationale: Honcho documents a context() call that returns curated reasoning plus conversation history 'to maintain continuity,' and lets developers shape retrieval with summaries and token budgets. Session context is also exposed as a queryable output, which directly supports an agent resuming a prior conversation. missing for 10: detailed docs on how session/thread summaries are generated and retrieved (API shape, cross-session scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
